svg.title: Harbor Goods wave 1: warehouse application moves from the data center to AWS
svg.desc: Warehouse staff and the storefront reach the application through Route 53 private zones. AWS DMS copies PostgreSQL 14 from the data center to RDS for PostgreSQL 16 over the Site-to-Site VPN with a full load, then CDC. At cutover the write freeze starts, replication drains, validation and smoke tests pass and the Route 53 weights flip from the data center to the internal ALB and ECS on Fargate. A reverse CDC task keeps the old database current for a seven-day rollback.
svg.text: HARBOR GOODS WAVE 1 · DATA CENTER TO AWS

g.text: AWS Cloud · us-east-1 · VPC 10.60.0.0/16 · two AZs · nothing internet-facing
Today: the warehouse app and PostgreSQL 14 run in the data center
DMS full load, then CDC keeps RDS in step over the VPN
Write freeze, validate, then flip the Route 53 weights to AWS
Reverse CDC keeps a seven-day rollback path to the data center
